author: AWing_Pilot
what_it_is: This save starts player at the beginning of the game with all heart containers on three files named Link. Great for speed runs and new players alike.

gamefaqs.product: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then only the first 3072 bytes (pages 0-11) of a Controller Pak: one GameShark cart-save note "ZLZL" ext 1 (3BADD1E5/FADE), 7 pages: length 0x8000 + LZARI stream (1563 bytes) of the 32 KiB SRAM

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-1998.11670.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 3072 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header, padded with 00 to 32 KiB; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD wrong in every copy, rewritten as 0101/FEF1; cart-save note 'ZLZL' (GameShark 3BADD1E5/FADE): LZARI, 1563 bytes -> 32768

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

rom.name: Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time (USA) (Rev 2).z64

mupen64plus-next.detail: three files "Link", each 0 deaths and 20 hearts, nothing else: as described

parallel-n64.detail: File 1 "Link": 0 deaths, 20 hearts, no stones or medallions

mupen64plus.detail: "Open this file?" File 1 "Link": 0 deaths, 20 hearts; then in Link's house with 20 hearts

note: A GameShark LZARI-compressed copy of the cartridge SRAM in a DexDrive file that stops after page 11 of the pak (padded with 00). The cartridge revision is not recorded; Rev 2 used.
